Container.Name: texturecraft-web
Container.Overview: TextureCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that serves TextureCraft, a 3D texture-painting application, through a browser-based WebAssembly interface. Work with 3D models and paint or create textures using the upstream application. The browser application uses local device graphics capabilities; the container only serves the static frontend and does not provide remote desktop or server-side rendering.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: TextureCraft Texture Craft 3D Texture Painting Texturing PBR Materials UV Mesh Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges, database, or persistent data volumes are required for the standard deployment. The web interface is served over HTTP on container port 8080. Browser graphics support and device performance affect the experience. WebGPU requires a secure context; use HTTPS through a reverse proxy for remote access. WebGL2 fallback availability depends on the browser and device.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the TextureCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
